reason: Core changes to IExtensionManager (new default-interface overloads, obsoleting old array-based methods) and a refactor of CompositionStrategy's dependency-matching logic are widely used across every tenant's shell composition, but the refactor appears logically equivalent, is backward-compatible via default interface methods, and is backed by substantial new unit tests.
